description:
"Wanna date for just six months?" 

Exhausted by her father's constant pressure to go on arranged dates, Chaeyun plans to study abroad in six months and proposes a contract relationship to her childhood friend, Taesan. Looking at Chaeyun's sparkling eyes, Taesan smiled meaningfully and said, "Well, there are a lot of things I want to do with a lover... Can you handle it?" 

"Of course! Just name it." 

"Alright. For six months, in exchange for being your boyfriend, I'm going to do everything a lover can do." 

At that moment, Chaeyun became the temporary lover of Taesan, the male friend who used to feel like family.
